newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: SLOVENIA SBI INDEX UP 1.46 PCT, SEEN DRIFTING.
newsitem.headline: SLOVENIA SBI INDEX UP 1.46 PCT, SEEN DRIFTING.

text.p: Slovenia's blue-chip SBI index rose 1.46 percent on Tuesday extending its winning run into the sixth day in a market eyeing the return of foreign investors, traders said.
"When foreigners return from their holidays, activity will be much livelier -- over the short-term I expect the index to stabilise at these levels," said Tomi Apollonio, an analyst at A Bank.
* The SBI index rose 1.46 percent or 23.14 points to 1,611.06.
* Trading firm Kovinotehna was the most actively traded stock, rising 3.06 percent to 572 tolars on volume of 7,082 shares.
* Brokerage Dadas was the top gainer, jumping 7.49 percent to 7,890 tolars on volume of 107 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
